_about: The promise this project makes, organised by scenario rather than by binary. status: ok = same as x86/macOS / partial = main path works, something specific missing / no = not possible. evidence is a command you can run; exit codes: 0 verified, 1 real failure, 2 could not be verified. Human-readable copy in PARITY.md (English) and zh/PARITY.md (Chinese) — all three must be changed together.

scenarios.scenario: Build a debug/release APK with Gradle/AGP
scenarios.note: Precondition: AGP does not use the aapt2 in your SDK, it resolves an x86_64 one from Maven. Set android.aapt2FromMavenOverride to ours (put it in ~/.gradle/gradle.properties to cover every project); tools/install.sh writes it for you

scenarios.scenario: Build native code with CMake (NDK toolchain file)

scenarios.note: tests/hello-native uses externalNativeBuild{cmake}; measured: AGP ran configureCMake/buildCMake tasks

scenarios.scenario: React Native: compile JS to Hermes bytecode
Install to a phone and read logcat

scenarios.note: Fixed 2026-08-30: static bionic enables fdsan, which hits a latent fd-ownership bug upstream and aborts on startup. See patches/adb/README.md

scenarios.scenario: Debug native code (lldb to a device)

scenarios.note: Pure Java, taken unmodified from Google, architecture-independent
Byte-compared against Google's output in the acceptance test
SDK_TEST_BASE_URL must end with a slash or sdkmanager silently ignores it

Command-line record/report works (measured: Samples: 1368). Missing libsimpleperf_report.so, the Python reporting path, because one process cannot mix bionic and glibc. Reading a device-recorded perf.data is not yet verified
scenarios.alternative: Copy perf.data to an x86 machine and use Google's Python scripts for graphical reports

scenarios.note: Google publishes no Linux ARM64 build (checked 2026-08-30: Windows, Mac, Mac ARM, Linux x64, ChromeOS). Studio is an IDE product, not an SDK component, so this project cannot fix it
scenarios.alternative: IntelliJ IDEA Community ships linuxARM64 (verified against JetBrains' releases API, 2025.3); or any editor plus the command-line paths above

scenarios.note: Google ships linux/x64, macosx/aarch64 and windows/x64 only. Deliberately not done; reasons in docs/zh/README.md roadmap item 7
scenarios.alternative: A real device over adb; or Cuttlefish (AOSP's own virtual device, which ships arm64 host packages) — needs KVM

scenarios.note: skiaparser is closed source and published for a fixed set of platforms (including macOS ARM64, not Linux ARM64); no source was found
